privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.technical.heading: Technical data
privacy.technical.body: To protect the forms and reactions from spam, I keep a hashed fingerprint of your IP address for a few minutes, never the IP itself. Reactions only store counts. Your browser only keeps your preferences (language, theme, keyboard shortcuts, the reactions you marked and how many times you woke up the “Careful, do not touch” buddy). I use no analytics or tracking cookies.
meta.privacy.title: Privacy
meta.privacy.description: What data I collect on this site, what I use it for and how to ask to review or delete it.
